title: festuca scabrifolia
intro: Festuca scabrifolia, commonly known as rough-leaved fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Festuca scabrifolia are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health and its potential uses in traditional medicine.
